description:
Create a 'Participatory Budgeting' survey for the 'Springfield 2026 Budget Consultation'. 

1. Create a new survey with that title.
2. Create a question group named 'Budget Allocation'.
3. Add a 'Multiple Numerical Input' question (Code: BUDGET) asking 'Please allocate 100% of the discretionary budget across these sectors:'.
4. Add these 5 sub-questions: Public Safety (SAFE), Infrastructure (INFRA), Parks & Recreation (PARK), Health Services (HLTH), General Government (GOV).
5. Configure the BUDGET question to use the 'Slider layout' and enforce that answers must sum to exactly 100 (Equals sum value = 100).
6. Add a second 'Long free text' question (Code: REASON) asking 'Please explain your focus on Infrastructure.'.
7. Set a condition/relevance equation so the REASON question ONLY appears if the Infrastructure allocation (INFRA) is greater than 40.
8. Activate the survey.
